sentences.text: MOTOR ACCIDENT CLAIMS TRIBUNAL-XIII, BELAGAVI, SITTING AT  GOKAK, IN MVC NO.2452/2016 AND ETC.,
THIS APPEAL COMING ON FOR ADMISSION THIS DAY,

THE  COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 -2-  NC: 2023:KHC-D:13457  MFA No. 101700 of 2018  JUDGMENT

This appeal is filed by the insurance company challenging the judgment and award dated 15.02.2018, passed in MVC No.2452/2016, by the XII Addl. District and Sessions Judge, and MACT-III, Belagavi, sitting at Gokak, to foist contributory negligence on the claimant as well as to reduce the quantum of compensation.

entities.text: XII Addl. District and Sessions Judge
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. The factum of accident, injuries sustained by the claimant in the accident and coverage of insurance are not in dispute in this case.

3. Heard the arguments and perused the material placed before the Court.
4.
In the present case the claimant has suffered fracture of right hand wrist and clavicle bone of right side.

The tribunal considered the functional disability at 9% and by holding income of Rs.7,000/-
per month, awarded compensation of Rs.1,13,400/- towards loss of future income on account of disability.
Considering the accident NC: 2023:KHC-D:13457 occurred in the year 2016, the notional income ought to have been taken at Rs.8,750/- per month.
But the tribunal has taken only Rs.7,000/- per month.
Even though the fractures are united, but the claimant being agriculturist and doing milk vending business, finding difficulty in lifting heavy objects.
Therefore, this causes disability in his working and earning capacity.

Therefore, the tribunal has correctly held 9%
disability to the whole body.
Therefore, the quantum of compensation awarded under the head loss of future income due to disability is found to be just and proper.

If the claimant has filed the appeal,
then on the notional income, the quantum would have been more.
Therefore, the compensation awarded under all the heads are found to be just and proper.
It needs no interference.
Therefore, the appeal is liable to be dismissed on this count.
5. It is another submission made by the counsel for appellant that the claimant has contributory rashness and negligence.
It is submitted that the claimant was NC: 2023:KHC-D:13457 riding his motorcycle without having driving licence.

Upon considering the Ex.P.4 spot sketch, the width of the The Oriental Insurance Co. Ltd vs Lakkappa Vithal Teggi on 18 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/79394647/
2 road is 12 feet.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The accident was caused at 4 feet on the left side of the road leading from Gujanatti to Jokanatti.
The claimant was riding the motorcycle from Gujanatti to Jokanatti.
The tractor was going from Jokanatti to Gujanatti.
Therefore it is proved that the driver of the tractor has moved the tractor towards wrong side and crossed his lane and dashed the motorcycle.
Therefore, the driver of the tractor is found to be completely rash and negligent in driving the tractor and caused the accident.
Non holding of the driving licence cannot be made a ground to show that the driver has contributory negligence.
On which direction the offending vehicle was going and whether has crossed his lane
are to be considered while deciding the aspect of contributory negligence.
But in the present case the claimant was on his correct side.
The tractor had moved to the wrong side and dashed the motorcycle.
Therefore, contributory NC: 2023:KHC-D:13457 negligence is not proved.
Hence on this count also the appeal is liable to be dismissed.

6. In the result, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER i) The appeal is dismissed.
ii) The judgment and award dated 15.02.2018, passed in MVC No.2452/2016, by the XII Addl. District and Sessions Judge, and MACT-III, Belagavi, sitting at Gokak, is hereby confirmed.

entities.text: XII Addl. District and Sessions Judge, and
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: iii) The amount in deposit shall be  transmitted to the tribunal.
iv) No order as to costs.
